title: Initial Meeting: From Online Connection to Business Partnership
theme: Transitioning from friendly online rapport to professional collaboration

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Hi Ruby! It's so nice to finally put a face to the name. How are you doing today?
dialogue.indonesian: Halo Ruby! Senang sekali akhirnya bisa bertemu langsung. Apa kabar hari ini?

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Hi You! I was thinking the same thing. I'm doing great, thank you. The cafe you picked is lovely.
dialogue.indonesian: Halo You! Aku juga berpikiran sama. Kabarku baik, terima kasih. Kafe yang kamu pilih ini cantik sekali.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I'm glad you like it. I come here often when I need a quiet place to think. Did you have any trouble finding it?
dialogue.indonesian: Syukurlah kalau kamu suka. Aku sering ke sini kalau butuh tempat tenang untuk berpikir. Tadi sulit tidak mencarinya?

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Not at all, the directions were perfect. It’s actually quite close to my office, surprisingly.
dialogue.indonesian: Sama sekali tidak, petunjuknya sudah pas. Ternyata cukup dekat dari kantorku, ya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: That's convenient! So, how has your week been so far? I know we've both been quite busy lately.
dialogue.indonesian: Wah, pas sekali kalau begitu! Jadi, bagaimana minggumu sejauh ini? Aku tahu kita berdua cukup sibuk akhir-akhir ini.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: It’s been a bit of a whirlwind, to be honest. But meeting up like this is a nice change of pace.
dialogue.indonesian: Jujur saja, agak padat sekali. Tapi bertemu seperti ini adalah perubahan suasana yang menyenangkan.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I agree. It’s funny how we’ve chatted so much online about the project, but we haven't talked much about ourselves.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku setuju. Lucu ya, kita sudah banyak mengobrol daring tentang proyek ini, tapi belum banyak bercerita tentang diri kita sendiri.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: True. I saw on your profile that you enjoy hiking? I've been wanting to try that lately.
dialogue.indonesian: Benar juga. Aku lihat di profilmu kalau kamu suka mendaki? Aku sedang ingin mencoba itu belakangan ini.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Oh, I love it! It’s the best way to disconnect. I can definitely recommend some beginner trails nearby if you're interested.
dialogue.indonesian: Oh, aku sangat suka! Itu cara terbaik untuk melepas penat. Aku bisa rekomendasikan beberapa jalur pemula di sekitar sini kalau kamu tertarik.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: I’d love that. It’s important to have a balance, especially with the kind of work we do.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku mau sekali. Penting untuk punya keseimbangan, apalagi dengan jenis pekerjaan yang kita jalani.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Exactly. Speaking of work, you've done some amazing things with your previous clients. I was very impressed by the portfolio you shared.
dialogue.indonesian: Tepat sekali. Bicara soal kerjaan, kamu sudah melakukan hal-hal luar biasa dengan klien sebelumnya. Aku sangat terkesan dengan portofolio yang kamu bagikan.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Thank you, You. That means a lot coming from you. I’ve heard great things about your leadership style as well.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih, You. Itu sangat berarti bagiku. Aku juga mendengar banyak hal baik tentang gaya kepemimpinanmu.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I appreciate that. I think the reason we connected so well online is because we share the same values regarding transparency and quality.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku hargai itu. Aku rasa alasan kita sangat nyambung saat mengobrol daring adalah karena kita punya nilai yang sama soal transparansi dan kualitas.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: I felt the same way. It’s rare to find a potential partner who views the process the same way I do.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku pun merasakannya. Jarang sekali menemukan calon mitra yang memandang proses kerja dengan cara yang sama denganku.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Since we're here, maybe we can dive a bit deeper into how we might actually collaborate on the upcoming launch?
dialogue.indonesian: Karena kita sudah di sini, mungkin kita bisa mulai membahas lebih dalam tentang bagaimana kita bisa berkolaborasi untuk peluncuran mendatang?

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: I was hoping you'd say that. I’ve been thinking about the timeline we discussed on LinkedIn.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku berharap kamu akan bilang begitu. Aku sudah memikirkan tentang linimasa yang kita diskusikan di LinkedIn.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: The timeline is flexible, but I want to make sure we don't rush the creative phase. What's your take on that?
dialogue.indonesian: Linimasanya fleksibel, tapi aku ingin memastikan kita tidak terburu-buru di fase kreatif. Bagaimana pendapatmu?

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Quality over speed, always. I think adding a week for the initial drafts would be beneficial for the end result.
dialogue.indonesian: Kualitas di atas kecepatan, selalu. Menurutku menambah satu minggu untuk draf awal akan sangat bermanfaat bagi hasil akhirnya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I completely agree. My main concern was the integration part, but seeing your workflow, I feel much more at ease.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku setuju sepenuhnya. Kekhawatiran utamaku tadinya di bagian integrasi, tapi melihat alur kerjamu, aku merasa jauh lebih tenang.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: That’s good to hear. I want this to be a smooth experience for your team as well. Communication is key.
dialogue.indonesian: Senang mendengarnya. Aku ingin ini menjadi pengalaman yang lancar bagi timmu juga. Komunikasi adalah kuncinya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: You're right. I’ve had issues in the past where communication broke down halfway through. It was quite a challenge to recover.
dialogue.indonesian: Kamu benar. Dulu aku pernah punya masalah di mana komunikasi terputus di tengah jalan. Cukup sulit untuk memulihkannya saat itu.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: I've faced that too. That’s why I prefer having these face-to-face meetings early on. It builds a different level of trust.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku juga pernah mengalaminya. Itulah sebabnya aku lebih suka pertemuan tatap muka di awal seperti ini. Ini membangun tingkat kepercayaan yang berbeda.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: It definitely does. You know, I feel like this conversation has already cleared up more than ten emails could have.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu saja. Tahu tidak, aku merasa percakapan ini sudah memperjelas lebih banyak hal daripada yang bisa dilakukan sepuluh email.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: I feel the same. It's much more natural. So, about the budget breakdown—is the proposal I sent within your expectations?
dialogue.indonesian: Aku juga merasa begitu. Jauh lebih alami. Jadi, soal rincian anggaran—apakah proposal yang kukirim sudah sesuai ekspektasimu?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: It is. It's fair and reflects the value you bring. I’ve already discussed it with my partners, and they are on board.
dialogue.indonesian: Sudah sesuai. Harganya adil dan mencerminkan nilai yang kamu berikan. Aku sudah mendiskusikannya dengan mitra-mitraku, dan mereka setuju.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: That’s fantastic news. I’m really excited to get started. I think we can make something really impactful together.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu kabar yang luar biasa. Aku sangat bersemangat untuk memulai. Aku rasa kita bisa membuat sesuatu yang berdampak besar bersama-sama.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I have no doubt about that. It feels like we're not just business partners, but already starting a good friendship.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku tidak ragu akan hal itu. Rasanya kita bukan sekadar mitra bisnis, tapi sudah mulai menjalin pertemanan yang baik.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: I feel that too, You. It’s been so easy talking to you today. No pressure at all.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku juga merasakannya, You. Mengobrol denganmu hari ini terasa sangat mudah. Tidak ada tekanan sama sekali.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Exactly how a first meeting should be. Let's wrap up for now, and I'll send over the formal contract by tomorrow morning.
dialogue.indonesian: Memang begitulah seharusnya pertemuan pertama. Mari kita cukupkan untuk sekarang, dan aku akan mengirimkan kontrak resminya besok pagi.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Sounds like a plan. I'll look out for that. Thank you so much for the coffee and the great chat, You.
dialogue.indonesian: Rencana yang bagus. Akan kutunggu. Terima kasih banyak untuk kopinya dan obrolan serunya, You.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: My pleasure, Ruby. I'm looking forward to our next meeting. Have a great afternoon!
dialogue.indonesian: Sama-sama, Ruby. Aku menantikan pertemuan kita berikutnya. Semoga siangmu menyenangkan!

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: You too! See you soon.
dialogue.indonesian: Kamu juga! Sampai jumpa lagi.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Wait, before I forget—do you have time for a quick tour of our office next week? It's just around the corner.
dialogue.indonesian: Tunggu, sebelum aku lupa—apakah kamu punya waktu untuk mampir sebentar ke kantor kami minggu depan? Letaknya dekat dari sini.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: I’d love to! Just send me the time that works for you, and I’ll be there.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku mau sekali! Kirim saja waktu yang pas untukmu, dan aku akan ke sana.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Perfect. It'll be great for you to meet the rest of the team. They’ve heard a lot about you.
dialogue.indonesian: Sempurna. Akan bagus jika kamu bisa bertemu anggota tim yang lain. Mereka sudah banyak dengar tentangmu.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: I'm looking forward to it. Thanks again, You. Goodbye!
dialogue.indonesian: Aku menantikannya. Terima kasih lagi, You. Mari!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Goodbye, Ruby. Take care!
dialogue.indonesian: Sampai jumpa, Ruby. Hati-hati di jalan!

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: By the way, You, I meant to ask—what was that book you mentioned on your post last week? The one about strategy?
dialogue.indonesian: Ngomong-ngomong, You, aku tadi ingin tanya—apa judul buku yang kamu sebut di postinganmu minggu lalu? Yang tentang strategi itu?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Oh, that was 'The Infinite Game' by Simon Sinek. It's a fantastic read for anyone in our field.
dialogue.indonesian: Oh, itu judulnya 'The Infinite Game' karya Simon Sinek. Bacaan yang luar biasa untuk siapa saja di bidang kita.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Ah, yes! I've heard of it but haven't picked it up yet. I'll definitely add it to my list.
dialogue.indonesian: Ah, ya! Aku pernah dengar tapi belum sempat beli. Pasti akan kumasukkan ke daftar bacaanku.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Actually, I have an extra copy at the office. I'll bring it for you next week when you visit.
dialogue.indonesian: Sebenarnya, aku punya salinan ekstra di kantor. Akan kubawakan untukmu minggu depan saat kamu berkunjung.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: That is so kind of you! Thank you, You. You're making this partnership very pleasant.
dialogue.indonesian: Kamu baik sekali! Terima kasih, You. Kamu membuat kemitraan ini jadi sangat menyenangkan.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Of course. I believe business should always be this personal and friendly.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu saja. Aku percaya bisnis seharusnya selalu sepersonal dan seramah ini.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: I couldn't agree more. Have a safe drive back!
dialogue.indonesian: Aku sangat setuju. Hati-hati dalam perjalanan pulang!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: You too. See you next week!
dialogue.indonesian: Kamu juga. Sampai jumpa minggu depan!

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Wait, You! One more thing—should I bring any specific documents for the meeting next week?
dialogue.indonesian: Tunggu, You! Satu hal lagi—apa aku perlu bawa dokumen khusus untuk pertemuan minggu depan?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: No need for physical documents. We'll just have a casual walkthrough and introduce you to the creative leads.
dialogue.indonesian: Tidak perlu bawa dokumen fisik. Kita hanya akan berkeliling santai dan mengenalkanmu ke para pemimpin kreatif.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Understood. That sounds perfect. I'm really looking forward to meeting the creative team.
dialogue.indonesian: Paham. Kedengarannya sempurna. Aku benar-benar menantikan pertemuan dengan tim kreatifnya.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: They are excited to meet you too. I told them about our online discussions, and they liked your approach.
dialogue.indonesian: Mereka juga bersemangat menemuimu. Aku ceritakan soal diskusi daring kita, dan mereka suka dengan pendekatanmu.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: That's great to hear. It’s always better when everyone is on the same page from the start.
dialogue.indonesian: Senang mendengarnya. Selalu lebih baik jika semua orang punya pemahaman yang sama dari awal.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Absolutely. Well, I really should let you go now. Don't want to keep you from your next appointment.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu saja. Baiklah, aku benar-benar harus membiarkanmu pergi sekarang. Tidak ingin menghambat janji temumu berikutnya.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: No worries. It was worth every minute. Talk soon!
dialogue.indonesian: Jangan khawatir. Setiap menitnya sangat berharga. Kita bicara lagi nanti!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Talk soon. Cheers!
dialogue.indonesian: Sampai nanti. Mari!

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Cheers!
dialogue.indonesian: Mari!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Oh, and Ruby, feel free to text me if you have any questions before then.
dialogue.indonesian: Oh, dan Ruby, jangan sungkan kirim pesan kalau ada pertanyaan sebelum hari itu.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Will do! Thanks for the offer. Bye!
dialogue.indonesian: Akan kulakukan! Terima kasih tawarannya. Dadah!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Actually, I forgot to ask about the weekend. Any plans?
dialogue.indonesian: Sebenarnya, aku lupa tanya soal akhir pekan. Ada rencana?

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Just catching up on some sleep and maybe a bit of gardening. You?
dialogue.indonesian: Cuma mau bayar utang tidur dan mungkin berkebun sedikit. Kamu sendiri?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: That sounds relaxing. I'm heading out for that hike I mentioned earlier.
dialogue.indonesian: Kedengarannya santai. Aku mau pergi mendaki seperti yang kusebutkan tadi.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Enjoy the fresh air! Talk to you on Monday.
dialogue.indonesian: Nikmati udara segarnya! Kita bicara lagi hari Senin.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Definitely. Take care, Ruby.
dialogue.indonesian: Pasti. Hati-hati, Ruby.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: You too, You. Bye!
dialogue.indonesian: Kamu juga, You. Dadah!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I'll make sure to send that email now while it's fresh in my mind.
dialogue.indonesian: Akan kupastikan kirim email itu sekarang mumpung masih ingat.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Perfect, I'll keep an eye out for it. Thanks again!
dialogue.indonesian: Sempurna, akan kupantau terus. Terima kasih lagi!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: No problem at all. Have a great day.
dialogue.indonesian: Bukan masalah. Semoga harimu menyenangkan.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: You as well. Bye for real this time!
dialogue.indonesian: Kamu juga. Kali ini benar-benar pamit!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Haha, alright. Bye!
dialogue.indonesian: Haha, baiklah. Sampai jumpa!

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Looking forward to working with you, You.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku menantikan bekerja sama denganmu, You.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Me too, Ruby. Me too.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku juga, Ruby. Aku juga.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: The coffee here really is great, by the way.
dialogue.indonesian: Ngomong-ngomong, kopi di sini memang enak sekali.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I'm glad you think so. Next time we can try their pastries, they're famous.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku senang kamu beranggapan begitu. Lain kali kita bisa coba kue-kuenya, mereka terkenal enak.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: It's a deal. See you then!
dialogue.indonesian: Setuju. Sampai nanti kalau begitu!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: See you!
dialogue.indonesian: Sampai jumpa!

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: I'm just checking my schedule for Monday... yes, 10 AM works for the office tour.
dialogue.indonesian: Aku sedang cek jadwal untuk hari Senin... ya, jam 10 pagi bisa untuk kunjungan kantor.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Excellent. 10 AM it is. I'll put it in my calendar.
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus sekali. Jam 10 pagi kalau begitu. Akan kumasukkan ke kalenderku.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Perfect. Now I really am leaving. Goodbye!
dialogue.indonesian: Sempurna. Sekarang aku benar-benar pergi. Dadah!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Goodbye Ruby, safe travels!
dialogue.indonesian: Sampai jumpa Ruby, hati-hati di jalan!

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Thanks, You!
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih, You!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Talk to you soon.
dialogue.indonesian: Sampai bicara lagi nanti.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Absolutely. Bye!
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu saja. Bye!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Wait, one last thing, Ruby—did you say you were looking for a new graphic designer for your team as well?
dialogue.indonesian: Tunggu, satu hal terakhir, Ruby—tadi kamu bilang kamu sedang mencari desainer grafis baru untuk timmu juga?

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Yes, I am. Do you have someone in mind?
dialogue.indonesian: Iya, benar. Apa kamu punya kandidat?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: I might. I'll send over a link to a portfolio when I get back to the office. Someone I worked with recently.
dialogue.indonesian: Mungkin ada. Akan kukirimkan tautan portofolionya saat aku kembali ke kantor. Seseorang yang baru-baru ini bekerja denganku.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: That would be incredibly helpful. Thank you for thinking of me.
dialogue.indonesian: Itu akan sangat membantu. Terima kasih sudah memikirkanku.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Of course. Helping each other out is what it's all about.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu saja. Saling membantu adalah intinya.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Truly appreciated. Okay, for real this time, goodbye!
dialogue.indonesian: Sangat kuhargai. Oke, kali ini beneran ya, sampai jumpa!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Haha, take care!
dialogue.indonesian: Haha, hati-hati!

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Bye!
dialogue.indonesian: Dah!

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.english: Thank you for the wonderful meeting, Ruby. It’s been a pleasure.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih untuk pertemuan yang luar biasa ini, Ruby. Sangat menyenangkan.

dialogue.speaker: Ruby
dialogue.english: Thank you too, You. I feel the same. See you soon!
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih juga, You. Aku merasakan hal yang sama. Sampai jumpa segera!
